representations.validation: Canonical/port size, alignment and all six field offsets match.

representations.representation: native free-list node inside a real reserved arena
port/game allocation bookkeeping record, not a serialized save record
port-owned compatibility metadata, separate from native arena MBlock
representations.invariant: Payload is pointer-aligned after the 28-byte bookkeeping header; base pointer and size metadata occupy distinct slots. Do not traverse this prefix as MBlock.

representations.representation: four-byte opaque test handles, not ExpHeap headers
representations.invariant: Never pass these tokens to native arena queries. Current type system does not enforce this distinction.
Resolve addresses through DS mapping; do not store native pointer bits in wire slots.

invariants.requirement: Distinguish real arena handles, test tokens, malloc-backed block metadata and serialized DS addresses.
Every active native arena view uses canonical offsets and alignment.
invariants.evidence: Official SDK layout: NNSiFndHeapHead.heapEnd at byte 56, ExpHeap 112 bytes aligned 8; generated gfl_heap now uses canonical NNSiFndHeapHead and typed heapEnd.

invariants.requirement: Free-list queries consume real arena nodes and calculate alignment from sizeof(MBlock).
invariants.exceptions: Does not prove host malloc availability or DS fragmentation semantics.

invariants.requirement: Cross-TU public signatures agree on pointer versus byte-count return.
invariants.evidence: GFL_HEAP_GetTotalFreeSize is u32(u32) and void*(u32) in actual compiled declarations.

invariants.requirement: Each block is freed once by its allocating backend; external arena backing is not freed by heap deletion.
A resize API that cannot return a replacement pointer must not move a malloc block.
invariants.evidence: LP64 GFL_HEAP_ResizeMemory reports in-place failure and preserves original allocation; end-to-end shrinking behavior unverified.

invariants.requirement: Specify whether queries measure reserved arena ranges, logical heap budget, or host allocator capacity.
invariants.evidence: LP64 malloc floor bypasses arena free-list consumption; query results must not be labelled host free memory.

invariants.requirement: Constructors initialize every field later read and reinitialization cannot invalidate live allocations silently.
invariants.evidence: Token initializer resets records; no live-allocation epoch policy established. Native floor attribute-prefix initialization needs review.

invariants.requirement: Address aliases do not suppress canonical implementations; small tools retain fallback aliases.
